messages:
Alice M: Quick notice — planning to deploy Zephyr-13b-v2 into model-catalog and route early traffic through Redwood Dedicated. Target window: 2025-11-02 22:00 UTC (staggered: 10% -> 50% -> 100%, ~20m per step). Need: runtime owner for smoke checks, rollback owner, and someone to pin final version in catalog. Ping @Ben, @Carmen, @Priya. :rocket:

Ben (Runtime): I can own runtime smoke checks. Will run warmup + sample prompts. Smoke checklist: 1) health endpoints ok; 2) P50/P95 token gen within expected; 3) kv-cache warm, no OOM. Quick command: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate -d '{"model":"zephyr-13b-v2","input":"Hello"}'`

Carmen SRE: I'll be rollback owner on-call window. Please confirm runbook: if we see >1% 5m error rate or P95 > 2.5s for >2 consecutive windows we rollback. Also need the canary host lists + grafana dashboard link. :white_check_mark:

Priya (PM): Acceptance criteria from product/dev: quality eval on 120 QA prompts — no more than 8 regressions vs baseline; latency P95 < 1.8s on Dedicated profile; and error rate < 0.5%. I'll post the eval set to the thread.

Ben (Runtime): For pinning: we'll update catalog entry with `pinned_version: v2` after final step. Console path: Console > Models > Zephyr-13b > Versions. Quick API to pin (staging): `POST /internal/catalog/models/zephyr-13b/pin -d '{"version":"v2"}'`

Alice M: Rollback steps (short): 1) Flip `model_routing` feature flag back to `zephyr-13b-v1`; 2) Pin v1 in catalog if needed; 3) Abort rollout job. Leo, Carmen will you confirm you can execute? @Leo (Oncall)

Leo (Oncall): I can execute rollback. Also leaving a small note: ensure DB migration for model metadata is backward-compatible — we've tested it in staging.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deployment job 983274 at 2025-11-02T22:00:00Z by alice.m. Staggered rollout configured: [10%,50%,100%] windows 20m each. Alerts wired to #eng-sre and paging.

Carmen SRE: ACK. Will watch grafana + error budget. Please add me to the runbook step to execute rollback command.

Ben (Runtime): ACK from runtime. I'll post smoke run results after each step with `smoke: pass` or `smoke: fail` and short metrics.

Alice M: Thanks — plan looks good. If no objections I'll kick at 22:00 UTC. Please react :thumbsup: if you're good.

Priya (PM): :thumbsup:

Leo (Oncall): :thumbsup:

Ben (Runtime): :thumbsup:

Carmen SRE: :thumbsup:
